title: ContextParamMap - Data API
description: Represents optional context data for a Conversation or a ConversationParticipant. This object is available in API version 57.0 and later.

ContextEntityId.description: The ID of the Conversation or ConversationParticipant record. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

MapKey.description: The key for the context data.

MapValue.description: The value for the context data.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<complexType name="ContextParamMap">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="ContextEntityId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="CreatedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="IsDeleted" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="MapKey" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="MapValue" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="SystemModstamp" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
<simpleType name="ID">
  <restriction base="xsd:string">
    <length value="18"/>
    <pattern value="[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}"/>
  </restriction>
</simpleType>
```
